sentences.en: Could we reschedule our meeting to next Thursday afternoon, since I have a prior commitment that conflicts with the original time?
sentences.zh: 我們可以把會議改到下週四下午嗎？因為我有一個之前的約會跟原定時間衝突了。

sentences.en: The event starts at seven in the evening, but I'd suggest arriving at least thirty minutes early to find a good seat.
sentences.zh: 活動晚上七點開始，但我建議至少提早三十分鐘到，才能找到好位子。

sentences.en: I completely lost track of time while working on the project, and before I knew it, three hours had already passed.
sentences.zh: 我做專案時完全忘了時間，不知不覺三個小時就過去了。

sentences.en: The deadline for submitting the application is the fifteenth of next month, which gives us roughly three weeks to prepare.
sentences.zh: 申請書的截止日期是下個月十五號，這大概給了我們三週的時間準備。

sentences.en: What time zone are you in right now, because I want to make sure we're both available when I schedule the video call?
sentences.zh: 你現在在哪個時區？因為我想確保安排視訊通話時我們雙方都有空。

sentences.en: I've been waiting here since quarter past nine, and it's now almost ten, so I'm starting to worry that something happened.
sentences.zh: 我從九點十五分就在這裡等了，現在快十點了，所以我開始擔心是不是發生了什麼事。

sentences.en: The store closes at nine on weekdays but stays open until eleven on weekends, which is much more convenient for me.
sentences.zh: 這家店平日九點關門但週末營業到十一點，這對我來說方便多了。

sentences.en: Let me check my calendar to see if I'm free on Saturday morning, because I might have a dentist appointment around that time.
sentences.zh: 讓我查一下行事曆看看週六早上有沒有空，因為那個時間附近我可能有牙醫預約。

sentences.en: The flight departs at six-fifteen in the morning, which means we need to leave for the airport no later than four.
sentences.zh: 班機早上六點十五分起飛，這意味著我們最晚四點就要出發去機場。

sentences.en: It's hard to believe that an entire year has passed since we last saw each other at the company's annual holiday party.
sentences.zh: 很難相信自從我們上次在公司年度假日派對見面以來，整整一年已經過去了。

sentences.en: I usually wake up around six-thirty on weekdays, but on weekends I allow myself to sleep in until at least nine.
sentences.zh: 我平日通常六點半左右起床，但週末我允許自己至少睡到九點。

sentences.en: The package should arrive within three to five business days, depending on the shipping method you selected at checkout.
sentences.zh: 包裹應該在三到五個工作天內送達，取決於你結帳時選的寄送方式。

sentences.en: By the time we finish this project, which is due in two weeks, we will have been working on it for over a month.
sentences.zh: 等我們完成這個兩週後到期的專案時，我們將已經花了超過一個月在上面。

sentences.en: The museum is open from ten to six on weekdays, but it closes earlier on Sundays, usually around four in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 博物館平日十點到六點開放，但週日比較早關，通常下午四點左右。

sentences.en: I can't remember whether the appointment was scheduled for this Wednesday or next, so let me double-check the confirmation email.
sentences.zh: 我不記得預約是排在這個禮拜三還是下個，讓我再確認一下確認信。

sentences.en: Time really flies when you're having fun — I can't believe we've already been chatting for over two hours.
sentences.zh: 開心的時候時間過得真快——我不敢相信我們已經聊了兩個多小時了。

sentences.en: The semester begins on September first and ends in mid-January, with a two-week break during the holidays in between.
sentences.zh: 學期九月一日開始，一月中結束，中間有兩週的假期休息。

sentences.en: If we leave right now, we should be able to make it to the theater before the show starts at half past eight.
sentences.zh: 如果我們現在就走，應該能在八點半表演開始前趕到劇院。

sentences.en: The last time I visited this city was five years ago, and so much has changed since then that I barely recognize it.
sentences.zh: 我上次造訪這個城市是五年前，從那以後變化太大了，我幾乎認不出來。

sentences.en: Could you remind me about the meeting fifteen minutes before it starts, because I tend to lose track of time easily?
sentences.zh: 你能在會議開始前十五分鐘提醒我嗎？因為我很容易忘記時間。

sentences.en: We've been stuck in traffic for nearly an hour, which means we'll probably arrive at least twenty minutes late.
sentences.zh: 我們已經塞車塞了將近一個小時，這意味著我們可能至少會遲到二十分鐘。

sentences.en: The countdown has already begun, and there are only seventy-two hours remaining before the registration window officially closes.
sentences.zh: 倒數計時已經開始了，距離報名窗口正式關閉只剩七十二個小時。

sentences.en: I try to set aside at least one hour every evening for reading, which has become a habit that I truly enjoy.
sentences.zh: 我試著每天晚上至少留一個小時閱讀，這已經成為我真心喜歡的習慣。

sentences.en: The project was supposed to be finished by Friday, but due to unexpected complications, we'll need an extension until next week.
sentences.zh: 專案原本應該在週五前完成，但由於突發狀況，我們需要延期到下週。

sentences.en: Spring starts in March and lasts through May, which is considered the best time to visit this region for its blooming flowers.
sentences.zh: 春天從三月開始持續到五月，這被認為是造訪這個地區欣賞花開的最佳時間。

sentences.en: I set three alarms every morning just to make sure I don't oversleep, especially on days when I have early meetings.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上設三個鬧鐘就是為了確保不會睡過頭，尤其是有早會的日子。

sentences.en: The restaurant's happy hour runs from four to six, during which time all appetizers and selected cocktails are half price.
sentences.zh: 餐廳的歡樂時光從四點到六點，在這段時間所有開胃菜和指定雞尾酒都半價。

sentences.en: I've been meaning to call you for days, but my schedule has been so packed that I couldn't find a free moment.
sentences.zh: 我好幾天前就想打電話給你了，但我的行程排得太滿，找不到空閒的時刻。

sentences.en: Our anniversary falls on a Tuesday this year, so we're planning to celebrate the weekend before with a nice dinner out.
sentences.zh: 今年我們的紀念日剛好是週二，所以我們打算前一個週末出去吃頓好的慶祝。

sentences.en: Daylight saving time begins next Sunday, which means we'll need to set our clocks forward by one hour before bed.
sentences.zh: 夏令時間下週日開始，這意味著我們睡前要把時鐘撥快一個小時。
